Dal aur Sooji ki Sambar Chaat! Crispy Sooji-Aloo Donuts + khatta-meetha sambar, ek dona khao aur pet bhar jaye
Bina pyaaz-lehsun, ghar ki simple cheezon se. Poonam Devnani ki tried-and-tested recipe, Masala Kitchen par.
Sooji-aloo ke crispy donuts: 1 cup sooji, 2 cup paani, bina lumps
Khatta-meetha-teekha sambar: kairi/imli, gud aur ghar ka sambar powder
Fry, air fryer ya oven (180-200C) — jo aapko pasand ho
Bache donuts 2-3 din fridge mein: nashte, lunch, dinner ya mehmaan ke liye
Comment karein — aap donuts fry karenge ya bake? Neeche batayein
